============================
Credits List
============================

Java Aspects was made by AgentMindStorm:

YouTube: @AgentMS
Bluesky: @agentms.bsky.social
Discord: agentms

This pack uses a few assets from version 6.4.6 of the PC GUI Pack. These include some splashes, some sounds, and the hover tooltip border.
PC GUI was made by Cris (@CrisXolt on Twitter/X), Sprintermax (@Sprintermax on Twitter/X), HawfHuman (@HawfHuman on Twitter/X), and SirZeus.

This pack also uses assets from version 1.15 of the Fixed Vanilla resource pack. These are the Detached System, first-person hand animations, all attachable animations, snowy grass side texture, blackstone stair and slab textures, purple glazed terracotta texture, activated observer back texture, spyglass texture, classic clouds, 3D thrown items, bobbing animation, swimming animation, crawling animation, sneaking animation, elytra position, panda sneezing animation, baby zombie leg animation, piglin celebrating animation, hoglin and zoglin attack animation, baby hoglin and zoglin walking animation, wolf tail animation, flopping tropical fish animation, cat and ocelot models and animations, parrot model and animations, squid model, shulker size, strider textures and model, villager models, zombie villager models, hoglin and zoglin models, piglin clothing and tusk size, horse textures, donkey texture, mule texture, parrot textures, camel texture, warm frog texture, pillager and vindicator textures, invisible phantom texture, potion particles, item frame breaking particles, bubble column splashing particles, normal and sticky pistons, bee nest and hive placing sounds, slowness effect icon, dirt UI background texture, sign UI textures, spectator player transparency, and command helper previews.
Fixed Vanilla was made by LateLag (@LateLagMC on Twitter/X).

This pack also uses assets from version 1.0.0 of the Java Edition Particles resource pack and version 1.21 of the MultiPixel resource pack. These are the player.entity.json editing method, loading bars, transparent water texture, grass block side transition colors, grass and fern textures, action bar bed messages, glow squid and blaze lighting, hurt and burning entity overlay values, semitransparent experience orbs, separated llama decor, separated pig saddles, semitransparent shulker bullets, wolves darkening when wet, zombie villager robe sizing, enderman shaking animation, zombie chasing and attacking animations, creeper exploding animation, cape animation, Wither armor size, dripping particles, flame particles, smoke particles, critical hit particles, glow squid particles, sculk sensor particles, sculk shrieker particles, totem of undying particles, eating particles, breaking particles, note block particles, splashing particles, ominous item spawning particles, and other miscellaneous particle changes.
The optional ZIP file "java_armless_armor_stands.zip" is also from the pack.
Java Edition Particles and MultiPixel were made by Rainvay_ZCYF (@ZouChenyunfei on Twitter/X).

This pack also uses assets from version 2.5.0 of Lukas' Java Parity Pack. These are the hurt and burning entity overlay methods, highlightable locked trades, selected item count position, item inventory icons, item durability bars, coordinate text and background color, item description colors, the removal of the flying item renderer, the removal of chat censoring, the removal of chat block previews, the removal of HUD item description text, and the removal of category text.
Lukas' Java Parity Pack was made by Lukas (@LukasPAH on Twitter/X).

============================
Credits Policy
============================

By contributing a feature to AgentMindStorm, you agree to the following terms:

The name of the contributor and their preferred social media account will be added to the Credits document, along with the features they contributed.

If one of these contributed features is later removed from the pack, the contributor's credit will remain in the Credits List, but the feature will be removed from their line. If all features from a single contributor have been removed from the pack, the list of features they contributed will say "Obsolete features".

Features contributed after July 17, 2023 cannot be removed by request of the contributor. This is to prevent extra work required to remove and redo features when a contributor asks to remove them.

Once a feature has been contributed to AgentMindStorm, or a creator has an agreement to share assets with him, he gains full modification and distribution rights over these features, including all assets (except those which may be owned by Mojang Studios, such as textures) and the right to monetize the features. He may reuse the same features in other resource packs (e.g. A feature contributed for Java Aspects may be used in Console Aspects as well.) He guarantees proper credit until the end of time for contributed features, which will be listed explicitly in the Credits document.

If you wish to use a feature from this pack in your own resource pack, please contact AgentMindStorm on Bluesky (@agentms.bsky.social) or Discord (agentms). AgentMindStorm will not permit you to take features which were contributed from someone else, but he may allow you to use any number of assets from features he created. You must have permission in writing directly from AgentMindStorm; this policy does NOT give permission to reuse assets on its own. For features AgentMindStorm received from a contributor, please contact the contributor directly for permission.
